messages:
harper: Kicking off tonight's v2 default switch at 2024-09-02T01:00Z. Any last-minute tenant holds?

deploy-bot: Scheduled by @harper. Canary plan: 8% (12m) -> 40% (18m) -> 100% if healthy. Auto-rollback: global 5xx > 2% OR p95 > baseline + 45% for 10m.

leo: FYI mobile SDK 2.1.0 normalizes version header but ~0.3% clients still on 2.0. I put a pinlist on S3: s3://rwd-release/pins/sep02-mobile-legacy.json (512 tenants).

sam: Runtime team loaded EU kernel patch in canary image v2.0.1-cand that should lower p95 for long sequences.

harper: Can we run canary with that image in EU only then ramp global? Want to catch region regressions without full blast.

deploy-bot: Canary scope set to global but image override applied for eu-region -> v2.0.1-cand. Traffic 8% started at 01:00Z.

ops: Monitoring dashboard: dash.rwd/rollout/6888888888. I'll watch eu p95 and per-tenant 5xx. Alert set: eu-p95 > baseline+30% for 5m -> notify.

leo: Early signal: eu p95 +28% but error rate flat. Not critical yet.

ops: Now eu p95 spike to +52% sustained 7m -> paging SRE.

harper: Hold. @sam run tenant pins for EU-heavy list and pause further ramp. Use pins/sep02-eu-heavy.json.

sam: Running:
```
rwdctl pins add --route /api/v2 --tenants-file pins/sep02-eu-heavy.json --reason "eu perf spike"
```
Output: Success: 275 tenants pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary ramp paused by operator @harper at 2024-09-02T01:07Z. No further increases.

release-manager: I'll note in release tracker: "paused - EU p95 regression; targeted tenant pins applied; kernel cand investigation." Will update release notes: include known issue and pin info.

leo: Investigating kernel candidate; initial flamegraphs show jitter at attention compute path for long prompts. Reproducing on staging.

harper: Decision rules restated: immediate auto-rollback if global 5xx >2% or p95 >45% across multiple regions. Single-region regressions -> prefer targeted pins and kernel tweak.

ops: Agreed. I'll keep alerts active and watch for error rate increase.

sam: ETA for patched kernel build: 20-30m. If validated we can replace EU canary image and resume ramp.

harper: Thanks. Keep updates short in this thread. We'll reopen operator window when EU cand validated. :white_check_mark:
